Package nl.pim16aap2.lightkeeper.protocol

Interface IProtocolValue

All Known Implementing Classes:
IProtocolValue.PBool, IProtocolValue.PDropped, IProtocolValue.PEnum, IProtocolValue.PList, IProtocolValue.PNumber, IProtocolValue.PRecord, IProtocolValue.PRef, IProtocolValue.PString, IProtocolValue.PUuid, IProtocolValue.PVec
public sealed interface IProtocolValue permits IProtocolValue.PString, IProtocolValue.PNumber, IProtocolValue.PBool, IProtocolValue.PUuid, IProtocolValue.PEnum, IProtocolValue.PVec, IProtocolValue.PList, IProtocolValue.PRecord, IProtocolValue.PRef, IProtocolValue.PDropped
Typed wire envelope for structured payload values.

Every value crossing the agent protocol as part of a structured payload (e.g. captured event fields) is one of these leaves. The envelope replaces flat string-only payloads: consumers receive real types, nesting is explicit (IProtocolValue.PList, IProtocolValue.PRecord), identities travel as references (IProtocolValue.PRef), and values the encoder cannot represent are reported as IProtocolValue.PDropped markers instead of being silently skipped.

Jackson uses the "type" JSON property to select the correct leaf during deserialization; adding a leaf requires a new JsonSubTypes.Type entry and a permits entry here.
